Test: SED attach and light-sleep floor on an H2 DevKit (G-02)
Method: Attach to the boris OTBR as a sleepy end device with the openthread crate; measure module current between polls
Acceptance limit: Stays attached for 24 h; light-sleep floor recorded (datasheet 25 uA)

Test: Energy of one unchanged 60 s check
Method: Power analyser across a full cycle at -2 dBm, +7 dBm and automatic TX power
Acceptance limit: Recorded per power level; nominal model assumes about 5 mJ from the cell

Test: Light sleep versus deep sleep per minute
Method: Compare light-sleep wake against deep-sleep reboot with Thread restore
Acceptance limit: Choose deep sleep for the 60 s cadence only if it costs under about 3.6 mJ more per cycle than light sleep

Method: Fetch nearly blank, realistic dashboard and random four-ink frames; 256, 512 and 1024-byte blocks; SED versus rx-on-when-idle
Acceptance limit: Recorded; nominal model allows 0.8 J per refresh
Pinout, chip-select count, BUSY polarity, scan direction and ink codes recorded in docs and slate-protocol

Method: Power analyser on the panel rail across a 25 s full waveform
Power analyser on the panel rail across a 20 s fast waveform
Cycle red, yellow, black and white boundary patterns with fast refresh; compare with full
Acceptance limit: No visible ghosting or colour shift the owner rejects over 100 cycles; required before fast becomes the default

Method: Sleep command, load switch off, wait minutes and hours, re-enable and refresh
Acceptance limit: Image retained while off; controller reinitialises every time

Test: No back-powering of the unpowered panel
Method: Measure the panel rail with the load switch off across boot, sleep and USB attach

Test: Whole-board sleep current at the battery connector
Method: Current analyser in series with the pack in normal light-sleep idle
Acceptance limit: 30 to 40 uA expected; investigate anything above 50 uA

Method: Charge from about 3.5 V with the chosen pouch in the enclosure; thermocouple on charger and pouch
Acceptance limit: Charger and pouch temperatures within their ratings; charge completes

Method: Plug and unplug USB while idle and during a refresh
Acceptance limit: Console and flashing always available with USB; normal sleep resumes on unplug

Method: Provision dataset, server and id over the console; reboot
Acceptance limit: Attaches and checks after reboot; dataset never printed

Method: Stop OTBR for 1 h and for 8 h
Acceptance limit: Backoff follows docs/firmware.md; reattaches within one retry after OTBR returns

Method: Bench supply sweep through the band thresholds
Acceptance limit: Bands and hysteresis as docs/firmware.md; no waveform below critical

Method: Run OTBR with the RCP; form the network; ping a DevKit's mesh address from the Omni container

Test: No waveform on a bad frame
Method: Serve truncated, CRC-corrupted, wrong-version and overlong frames
Acceptance limit: Panel powers down without a waveform every time; old version kept and reported

Method: Hold BUSY active past 40 s on the bench
Acceptance limit: Waveform fault raised, panel powered down, next check reports it
